question_answered: Top US-listed stocks (including ADRs) discussed this week that pass quality and risk checks
market: US-listed common stocks, REITs and ADRs (foreign companies traded in the US) on NYSE American, Nasdaq, NYSE

sources.name: StockTwits
sources.used_for: what retail traders are discussing, their own Bullish/Bearish tags

sources.name: Yahoo Finance (yfinance)
sources.used_for: market cap, price, trading volume, P/E, revenue growth, debt/equity, volatility

sources.name: Finnhub
sources.used_for: list of US-listed common stocks, earnings calendar, fallback fundamentals

funnel.stage: StockTwits posts kept after removing bots and spam
Passed market, volume, distinct-user and fundamentals filters
Passed AI catalyst, hype and sarcasm review
Final picks after risk and diversification checks

methodology.name: Bot elimination and ticker extraction
methodology.what: Drops posts from accounts under 30 days old, with under 3 followers, posting more than 5 times a minute, or copy-pasting the same text. Finds tickers from cashtags, exchange tags and company names, limited to stocks listed on NYSE, Nasdaq and NYSE American, including ADRs of foreign companies such as TSMC or Alibaba.

methodology.name: Market and volume hard filters
methodology.what: Requires market cap of at least $300M, price above $1, real trading liquidity and history; no SPACs. Chatter must be unusual (z-score), come from many different users (70%+ unique), and be confirmed by real trading volume. Fundamentals: positive P/E up to 60, growing revenue, debt/equity up to 200%.

methodology.name: Sentiment scoring
methodology.what: Normalises emojis and slang, isolates each ticker in multi-ticker posts, scores with FinBERT plus a trader-slang dictionary, one vote per user.

methodology.name: AI catalyst and sarcasm review
methodology.what: An LLM explains why each stock is discussed and must cite real headlines. Hype, meme and spam driven interest, negative or minor catalysts are rejected; sarcastic posts are re-scored.

methodology.name: Risk checks and diversification
methodology.what: Removes stocks that already jumped over 20% in 5 days, are very overbought or very volatile; flags earnings within 7 days and high short interest; max 2 per sector and no near-duplicates.

limitations: StockTwits only returns the latest ~30 posts per ticker each time data is collected, so counts are samples.
Catalyst summaries are written by an AI model from the linked headlines; check the sources.
Market data comes from Yahoo Finance and may contain errors.

Each screen covers the last 7 days, but only 2 daily run(s) are saved as a baseline, so 'unusual chatter' compares each stock with the other stocks, not with its own normal level (needs 3+ daily runs).
The sentiment model agrees with traders' own Bullish/Bearish tags 71% of the time (balanced accuracy; 50% = guessing).
disclaimer: This is an automated screen of social-media and news chatter for a student project. It is not investment advice. Do your own research before buying or selling anything.
